options.A: $\ce{Cl2}$ has the longest bond and dissociates into atoms most readily.
options.B: $\ce{I2}$ has the longest bond and dissociates into atoms most readily.
options.C: $\ce{I2}$ has the shortest bond and dissociates into atoms most readily.
options.D: All three molecules dissociate equally readily because each contains one single bond.
